presentation: Original connected overhead body/head, narrower shoulders and readable wine-red hair
source_policy: All seven existing source PNG byte hashes are unchanged. Runtime nearest-sampled shoulder narrowing preserves the authored gait and crown scale; shader palette uses dark roots and visible red lengths.
animation: Signed real travelled distance selects authored poses; no fixed-rate standalone clip clock.
standing_legs: No independent front-view trouser/shin sprites; the authored body supplies overhead shoe/hand silhouettes.
peaceful_weapon: Unarmed body and hidden held weapon; existing compact carbine sling remains on the back.
held_weapons: Existing cone pistol, cone shotgun and baton retain their source sizes; normal conventional rifle pixels are masked in the armed body shader.
head_contour_authority: Original crown in the same connected body frame; unchanged head scale while broad unarmed shoulders are narrowed. Original outer black crown contour and small nose edge retained.

back_carbine_placement.reason: Across the back shoulder line, entirely behind the original head contour rather than cutting across the skull.

head_palette.scope: Original scalp pixels only; no front-facing portrait overlay.

jacket_palette.outer_contours: Original outer black pixels remain unchanged; only enclosed jacket folds outside the head are lifted.

experimental_variants: Compact portrait/crown overlay was rejected and is not present in production.

fallen_trousers_palette.scope: Only the five-frame fall strip. The two standing source strips have no matching opaque pixels.

shoulder_width.physics: Collision radius7, hitbox7 and muzzle18 unchanged.
